archive.source: historical_prices/json_files — daily OHLCV, no intraday, no bid/ask.

market.note: Median across every stock in the archive except mutual funds and corporate bonds.

blockTrades.note: Block-trade counts as recorded in the daily archive. Sparse by construction: a block trade is a negotiated off-market transaction, and the archive carries only the daily count and quantity — never the price, side or counterparty.

rsi.note: This app computes RSI from a plain simple average of gains and losses over the lookback. Wilder's original smooths those averages forward. Both are computed here on identical closes so the gap between them is measured, not assumed.

fairValueGaps.note: A gap counts as filled when a later bar trades back through the far edge of it. Gaps without the full forward window available are excluded rather than counted unfilled. "control" repeats the identical question at a random non-gap bar in the same stock, using a level the same distance away in the same direction — without it a fill rate measures how much price moves, not whether gaps are special.
